LESSON: TWAHARA TYPES OF NAJASAAT

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.1: Twahara Types of Najasaat

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Twahara Types of Najasaat. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: how to purify different najasaat individually/in pairs/in groups. 1. How do you purify najasaat?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. demonstrate appropriate ways of cleaning najasaat (impurities) for the purpose of purification

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: TWAHARA TYPES OF NAJASAAT
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 4
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Twahara Types of Najasaat helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: TWAHARA TYPES OF NAJASAAT
Study Twahara Types of Najasaat like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Demonstrate appropriate ways of cleaning najasaat (impurities) for the purpose of purification

What this means
In this part you learn to demonstrate appropriate ways of cleaning najasaat (impurities) for the purpose of purification. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: demonstrate appropriate ways of cleaning najasaat (impurities) for the purpose of purification.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Twahara Types of Najasaat” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can demonstrate appropriate ways of cleaning najasaat (impurities) for the purpose of purification. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Twahara Types of Najasaat is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Twahara Types of Najasaat” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: demonstrate appropriate ways of cleaning najasaat (impurities) for the purpose of purification)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Twahara Types of Najasaat to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: demonstrate appropriate ways of cleaning najasaat (impurities) for the purpose of purification.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Twahara Types of Najasaat from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Twahara Types of Najasaat: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 4 learner study Twahara Types of Najasaat?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how to purify different najasaat individually/in pairs/in groups. 1. How do you purify najasaat?
2. What items do you use in removing najasaat?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Twahara Types of Najasaat means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: demonstrate appropriate ways of cleaning najasaat (impurities) for the purpose of purification.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
